::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Beijing's flagship effort (under the '芯屏' strategy, pairing with BOE display demand) to backfill its weak manufacturing base: the Yandong listed company runs Beijing's first 8-inch volume line and a ¥7.5 billion 'domestic-toolset' 65nm 12-inch specialty line (first wafer April 2023, mass production end-2024); the bigger Beidian Integration (北电集成) 28nm 12-inch fab — ¥33 billion total, ¥20 billion capital — broke ground December 2024, topped out 2025, and took delivery of first equipment 10 December 2025, with company-targeted production start H2 2026.
:::

**Chinese name:** 北京燕东微电子股份有限公司 / 北京电控集成电路制造有限公司 (Běijīng Yàndōng Wēidiànzǐ)

## What does this facility make?

Power/analog/silicon-photonics wafers on 8-inch and 65nm 12-inch; planned 28nm DDIC/mixed-signal/MCU wafers on the Beidian line.

## Why does it matter?

One of the most domestic-equipment-heavy 300mm projects in China (NAURA is the headquartered-next-door tool supplier) — a live test of how far a Chinese fab can go on a partially domestic toolset at 28nm.
